name: Cyberpunk poster
description: Screen-printed posters and flat digital art of a neon dystopian future: bold flat colour, silhouettes, double-exposure figures framed by a city, holographic shine and dense ink linework, often symmetrical down a central street.
light: neon night: cyan and coral rim light on black, no sun
violet dusk, pink and electric blue haze, no sun
a giant red or pink sun or moon behind towers (this look only)
holographic iridescent sheen on flat black, no sun
composition: strict symmetry down a central street, a vanishing point behind a lone silhouette
double exposure: a city skyline inside a large silhouette on black (the only look with a big face)
a tall poster stuffed edge to edge with buildings, machines and debris
a small figure seen from behind facing a huge glowing skyline
camera_or_medium: limited-colour screen print and flat vector illustration with bold ink outlines; some painterly digital brushwork
texture_detail: halftone grain, flat colour separations, crisp ink linework, holographic foil sheen, slight print misregistration
avoid: giant faces or heads in the sky unless the composition asks for one
subjects: a lone rider silhouette at the end of a neon street
a city skyline inside the silhouette of a head
a towering poster of collapsing buildings and machines
two silhouettes on a rooftop watching a red sun over the city
